Usage: phoenix-ui link [options]

Link Phoenix UI skills from a verified local distribution.

Options:
  --source=<path>        Alias for --bundle-root
  --providers=<names>    Comma-separated harnesses to link
  -y, --yes              Accept detected defaults without prompting
  --force                Replace existing skill folders with links
  --bundle-root=<path>   Explicit local bundle; also PHOENIX_UI_BUNDLE_PATH
  --json                 Report unavailable/invalid input as JSON
  -h, --help             Show this help message
